cases.brief: Three supplied shots have exact scene lineage and visual, camera, lens, lighting, and performance records. One contains a cyan holographic map with unresolved interaction-light method, one requires invisible support-cable cleanup while preserving a hard contact shadow, and one is explicitly entirely in camera with no VFX requested.
observables: Produces one strict schema-valid vfx-plan object with exact positive ORBIT-FX###, ORBIT-UNC###, ORBIT-APR###, and ORBIT-SBE### IDs where applicable, and only declared fields.

Copies every supplied scene with its source reference and every project-owned scene-derived shot into source_context, with exact shot-scoped visual, camera, lens, lighting, and performance category/value/source_reference triples.

Uses exactly one camera, lens, and lighting metadata claim for each effect shot, exact-binds supplied claims, and links any approved claim or confirmed decision to structured source-bound approval evidence with the exact approved metadata triple, simulation requirements, or boundary scopes.
Classifies every shot exactly once, inverse-links effect shots and effect IDs, and keeps the no-VFX shot separate with no collision.

Plans purpose, decomposition, boundary, clean plate, tracking, metadata, mattes or holdouts, reference, interaction, simulation, elements, integration, continuity, dependencies, human-safety handoff, and observable acceptance criteria for both effects.

Keeps the hologram boundary unresolved and bidirectionally linked to its owned uncertainty; it does not confirm an emitter, digital treatment, simulation, or capture method without exact approval or supplied-boundary evidence.
Preserves the cleanup shot's key, still hand, locked 75 mm framing, warm desk light, and hard contact shadow while requiring invisible, temporally stable support removal.
Contains no vendor, software, generated or embedded media, URL, credential, NLE/DCC control, budget, schedule, casting, procurement, legal decision, or safety approval.

cases.brief: A supplied live-action shoreline shot extends a practical creature torso below the waterline. Camera move, 50 mm lens, overcast side light, performer eyeline, contact point, wet response, and safety-sensitive water interaction are supplied. Limb anatomy, marker plan, clean-plate availability, displacement, and simulation method are unresolved.
observables: Preserves exact project-owned shot lineage and exact-binds supplied camera, lens, light, performance, contact, and surface facts.
Decomposes photographed torso, created lower anatomy, waterline occlusion, contact, reflection, wet response, displacement, and continuity without inventing anatomy or physical certainty.
Makes live-action-appropriate plate, tracking, reference, matte or holdout, practical interaction, lens/light metadata, and capture-element decisions.

Lists each unresolved plate, marker, anatomy, boundary, displacement, and simulation question on both its effect and owned uncertainty, and never marks it confirmed without exact approval or supplied-boundary evidence.
Routes marker placement, performer proximity, and water interaction to qualified human-safety review without declaring a method safe or approved.
Uses observable acceptance criteria for contact, waterline integration, tracking, lens/light coherence, eyeline, and continuity without prescribing software or a vendor.

cases.brief: A fully animated energy ribbon crosses a character, separates into three streams, illuminates a matte surface, passes between holdouts, then reforms in the next supplied shot. Camera, lens language, palette, performance timing, entry/exit state, and continuity are supplied. Flow behavior is approved; density variation remains unresolved.
observables: Creates a schema-valid two-shot effect graph with exact project lineage, structured scene provenance, exact source binding, inverse applicability, and continuity ownership.
Waives photographic clean plates and live reference capture with reasons while using authored design, motion, lighting, and style references.
Plans supplied stylization, stream separation, matte/holdout ordering, authored light response, confirmed flow requirements, integration, and cross-shot reforming state.

Uses exact supplied-boundary evidence for an already supplied all-authored/no-practical boundary, retaining density as the only boundary-independent uncertainty; confirmed flow requirements carry no uncertainty and source-bound approval evidence with the identical approved requirements array.
Uses observable acceptance criteria for shape, timing, occlusion, illumination, simulation, and continuity without forcing live-action plates, markers, capture, or physical realism.
Remains vendor-neutral and includes no generated media, URLs, credentials, budgets, schedules, procurement, legal decisions, or safety claims.
